idea: Weekly Surge In Google Trends For Last Minute Vacation Bookings Signals Consumer Spending Spike

data.source: Google Trends weekly data for 'last minute vacation bookings'

behavior: A sudden surge in last minute vacation booking searches often precedes increased consumer discretionary spending in travel and leisure.

market_impact.rationale: Increased travel interest drives higher spending on leisure and hospitality-related stocks.

trade_logic.entry: If weekly Google Trends for 'last minute vacation bookings' rises more than 30% vs prior 4-week average
trade_logic.exit: After 3 weeks or if the trend falls below its 4-week average

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal and impulsive travel planning frequently spikes within weeks.
